_comment: artifactComponentDirs vs artifactChildDirsExtra resolves a real disagreement between the two hand-maintained taxonomy vocab copies this file replaces: framework/os/plugin/registry script.ts's TAXONOMY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENTS (5 dirs, the 'completeness' set every artifact must carry) vs root script.ts's POLICY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENT_DIRS (the same 5 plus ⚙️engine, which is allowed but not required). artifactComponentDirs = the required 5; artifactChildDirsExtra = additional dirs allowed as artifact children but not required. Do not merge these into one list. See master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE and mechanism ticket 26/08/05/TAXONOMY-VOCABULARY-AND-PACKAGE-DISCOVERY-CONTRACT.
